empowered-to-lead.title: EMPOWERED TO LEAD
empowered-to-lead.description: Empowered to Lead: Becoming a Leader Who Impacts the World by Dr. Billy Wilson equips you to lead with integrity, courage, and vision—impacting the world through faith, wisdom, and Spirit-empowered leadership.

the-power-of-one.title: The Power Of One
the-power-of-one.description:
How can eight billion people have an authentic encounter with Jesus Christ?
The Power of One provides a clear and attainable path toward the renewal of the Great Commission.

born-4-the-storm.title: GENERATION Z BORN FOR THE STORM
born-4-the-storm.description: From the halls of middle schools to boardrooms of the most innovative companies in the world, Generation Z is coming of age at one of the most unique times in human history.

father-cry.title: Father Cry
father-cry.description: Father Cry addresses the generational longing for spiritual parents and the deep desire to experience the love of our heavenly Father.

fasting-forward.title: Fasting Forward
fasting-forward.description: In Fasting Forward, Dr. Billy Wilson shares the importance of fasting and how Christ-followers can advance their spiritual lives through practicing this ancient discipline.

el-poder-de-uno.title: El Poder de Uno
el-poder-de-uno.description: Que cada persona en la Tierra tenga un encuentro auténtico con JESUCRISTO a través del poder y la presencia del Espíritu Santo . . . antes del Pentecostés 2033.

ayunar-para-avanzar.title: Ayunar Para Avanzar
ayunar-para-avanzar.description: En Ayunar para avanzar, el Dr. Billy Wilson comparte la importancia del ayuno y cómo los seguidores de Cristo pueden crecer en sus vidas espirituales a través de la práctica de esta antigua disciplina.
